description: PRD-160 S5 seeded NL2SQL eval set, grown to 32 by PRD-199 S3 (joins/dates/negations/ambiguity). golden_sql is the reference; the harness compares a candidate's result set to the golden's (execution accuracy). Portable SQL (SQLite + Postgres).

questions.question: How many customers are there?
questions.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

questions.question: List all products in the Software category
questions.golden_sql: SELECT * FROM products WHERE category = 'Software'

questions.question: What is the total revenue across all orders?
questions.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(total) FROM orders

questions.question: How many orders did each customer place?
questions.golden_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id

questions.question: What are the three most expensive products?
questions.golden_sql: SELECT * FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: How many customers are from the USA?
questions.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE country = 'USA'

questions.question: What is the average order total?
questions.golden_sql: SELECT AVG(total) FROM orders

questions.question: List the orders that are completed
questions.golden_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

questions.question: Show each product category and how many products are in it
questions.golden_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY category

questions.question: What is the total quantity sold per product?
questions.golden_sql: SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id

questions.question: Which customers have placed at least one order? Show their names.
questions.golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id

questions.question: How many active customers are there?
questions.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE status = 'active'

questions.question: List the top 5 customers by total order value
questions.golden_sql: SELECT customer_id, SUM(total) AS total_value FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY total_value DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: What is the single most expensive product?
questions.golden_sql: SELECT * FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many orders are there in total?
questions.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

questions.question: List hardware products ordered from cheapest to most expensive
questions.golden_sql: SELECT * FROM products WHERE category = 'Hardware' ORDER BY price ASC

questions.question: What is the total value of completed orders?
questions.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(total) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

questions.question: Which customers placed more than one order? Show the customer id and order count.
questions.golden_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

questions.question: What is the total revenue per country?
questions.golden_sql: SELECT c.country, SUM(o.total) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.country

questions.question: List the distinct order statuses
questions.golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT status FROM orders

questions.question: Which products has Acme Corp ordered? List the product names.
questions.golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.name FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Acme Corp'

questions.question: What is the total revenue per product name, highest first?
questions.golden_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

questions.question: Which customers have never placed an order? Show their names.
questions.golden_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

questions.question: How many orders were placed in May 2025?
questions.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-05-01' AND order_date <= '2025-05-31'

questions.question: What is the most recent order? Show its id and date.
questions.golden_sql: SELECT id, order_date FROM orders ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the total value of orders placed before April 2025?
questions.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(total) FROM orders WHERE order_date < '2025-04-01'

questions.question: List the products that are not in the Accessory category.
questions.golden_sql: SELECT * FROM products WHERE category <> 'Accessory'

questions.question: How many orders are not completed?
questions.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status <> 'completed'

questions.question: Which products appear in exactly one order? Show their names.
questions.golden_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) = 1

questions.question: Show the names of active customers who have no completed orders.
questions.golden_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE status = 'active' AND id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed')

questions.question: What's our best-selling product by quantity? Show its name.
questions.golden_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How much have USA customers spent in total?
questions.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(o.total) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.country = 'USA'
